messages:
Incidentbot: :rotating_light: ALERT: elevated 5xx and connection resets observed from instances in eu-west-1b (az-b). Metric: nat_gateway_connection_errors spike 09:41 UTC. Auto-page sent.
PagerDuty: Paging Kiran (SRE) — urgent.
Kiran (SRE): Acked — I'm on call. starting triage. can folks paste quick scope: only az-b? any cross-az symptoms?
Leo (NetOps): seeing src nat translations failing for flows originating from subnets in az-b. VPC flow logs show TCP RSTs on return path. eip mappings look inconsistent: some traffic still trying to use eip-66.
Marta (Infra): we just finished a small TF run that rebalanced EIPs across NAT candidates 09:35 UTC — could be related. rolling change targeted nat-farm-azb.
Kiran (SRE): copy. sounds like conntrack + EIP remap mismatch -> packets get SNAT'd to old EIP but return path not accepting. mitigation plan: 1) fail traffic to standby NAT in az-a 2) scale nat capacity 3) notify CS. executing now.
Kiran (SRE): running quick discovery:
```
aws ec2 describe-nat-gateways --filters Name=tag:Role,Values=redwood-nat Name=state,Values=available --query 'NatGateways[*].[NatGatewayId,SubnetId,State,ConnectivityType,TagSet]' --region eu-west-1
```
Leo (NetOps): output shows nat-gw-0a1 (az-a) healthy, nat-gw-0b2 (az-b) flapping and has ElasticIpAssociation changed recently.
Marta (Infra): confirmed — terraform attach stepped in while a background job reallocated eip-66 to a new instance. that explains the translation drift. my bad, I'll pause automation.
Kiran (SRE): temporary route table change to point az-b private subnets to nat-gw-0a1 (fallback) to avoid cross-az eip mismatch. command:
```
aws ec2 replace-route --route-table-id rtb-0bsub --destination-cidr-block 0.0.0.0/0 --nat-gateway-id nat-gw-0a1 --region eu-west-1
```
Marta (Infra): applied replace-route to rtb-0bsub (subnet group private-b) at 09:48 UTC. propagation ~12s.
CS-Ops: customers A,B,C reported degraded API calls starting ~09:36. I'm posting a short status to status.redwood.ai and notifying top-tier accounts.
Kiran (SRE): monitoring p50/p95/p99 for egress lat and 5xx — so far p99 latency dropped back toward baseline, 5xx rates trending down.
Leo (NetOps): also seeing DNS TTL causing some upstream controllers to cache old EIP for a bit — worth noting for postmortem.
Marta (Infra): paused the TF automation and marked eip-66 as immutable while we stabilize. also creating a lockfile for nat reassigns.
Kiran (SRE): can someone run a conntrack dump on one of the NAT instances in az-b to confirm stale translations?
Leo (NetOps): ran: `sudo conntrack -L | grep 10.0.34.` — lots of entries pinned to old eip-66. flushing translations on nat host-0b2 now: `sudo conntrack -F` — will cause some short reconnections.
Marta (Infra): noted brief reconnections expected. CS-Ops, heads-up to expect a few reconnects while sessions rebuild.
CS-Ops: relayed to customers. they appreciate the quick mitigation.
Kiran (SRE): after conntrack flush + route switch, telemetry looks stable. no errors in service logs for the last 6m. marking incident as mitigation-success.
PagerDuty: Incident acknowledged, mitigation executed.
Kiran (SRE): I'm going to hand off to Marta for follow-up actions and postmortem (root cause: automation race that reallocated EIP while NAT host had live conntrack). Marta take?
Marta (Infra): taking postmortem. immediate action items I own: 1) add a pre-check in TF to avoid EIP moves when NAT active; 2) implement a maintenance lock for NAT EIPs; 3) add automated route-failover playbook (runbook doc link: https://internal.redwood/infra/runbooks/nat-failover).
Leo (NetOps): add item: surface EIP reassignment events to alerting (CloudTrail + metric) so we catch remaps earlier.
Kiran (SRE): also add test that verifies cross-az NAT failover in staging with conntrack flush to ensure graceful path.
Marta (Infra): will own creating the postmortem doc and assigning severity/impact. estimated customer minutes impacted: ~12–18m for some flows, larger customers saw retries but no data loss.
CS-Ops: collecting customer reports and will attach timeline.
Incidentbot: Incident resolved (mitigation applied). Closure candidate flagged by Kiran at 10:41 UTC.
Kiran (SRE): thanks all — final note: avoid manual EIP reassigns without lock; we should automate graceful handovers (drain conntrack via NAT agent) next. handing off to Marta for action tracking. :thumbsup:
